sources.snippet: huggingface_downloader is a native Dart utility for downloading complete model snapshots directly from Hugging Face Hub. It provides a lightweight implementation similar in spirit to Python's huggingface_hub.snapshot_download (), allowing Dart applications, AI runtimes, and CLI tools to fetch Hugging Face repositories without external Python ...
